items.html: But this difference is not in the number of the ten Sefirot themselves, for they are equal in all of ABYA. But the difference is in the Partzufim themselves, for the Partzufim of Beriah are not equal to those of Atzilut, and likewise those of Yetzirah to Beriah, and likewise those of Assiyah to Yetzirah. But the existence of the Partzufim is in all of ABYA.
